item.title: What are your retro game consoles worth?
item.description: Many variables affect the value of retro game consoles today. Which ones are worth keeping, and which ones are destined for the trash?

item.title: German defense giant tests moving truck launcher carrying 18 kamikaze drones
item.description: Rheinmetall tested a truck-mounted launcher carrying 18 FV-014 drones, demonstrating swarm capability, armour penetration, and long-range flight during live trials.

item.title: ‘Unprecedented’ number of Apple users received recent spyware alert, say investigators
item.description: Cybersecurity experts who investigate spyware attacks say the number of people who received a recent threat notification from Apple is unusually high.

item.description: Rogue Studios, a new cinematic adult AI-generator, is betting big on the future of “sophisticated” spicy content.

item.title: YouTube public view counts will likely get higher starting next week
item.description: The platform will start tracking views the same way across video formats.

item.title: Power on... Marvel's new X-Men movie cast reveal at D23 Expo 2026 — and why it proves leak culture is broken
item.description: With the official cast reveal for its new X-Men movie, Marvel exposed the legitimacy of numerous self-proclaimed insiders.

item.title: Russian websites could soon be easy pickings for hackers as security certificates expire — banks, emails, and government systems all potentially at risk
item.description: Russia's websites lost their trusted certificates, and the fix Moscow is offering asks users to install a state root that can vouch for any site on the internet.

item.title: Save up to $300 on your TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 pass until August 21
item.description: If you’ve been circling around Disrupt, then now’s the best time to lock in your pass and start getting ready to join the rest of the startup community gathering in San Francisco from October 13-15 at Moscone West!

item.title: Spotify’s new Playlist Notes let users and editors explain their song picks
item.description: Spotify launches a new feature that gives users a chance to explain the stories and reasoning behind their favorite music. Editors will be using the feature, too, on top playlists like RapCaviar and others.

item.title: Bethenny Frankel’s Supermodel Cafe gets a lukewarm response as skinny culture returns
item.description: The reality TV star has welcomed feedback on the new venture’s menu, but its branding may feel familiar to visitors who remember the late 2000s. Reality TV star and entrepreneur Bethenny Frankel has returned to the food and beverage space with a new pop-up cafe in the Hamptons. But despite long lines wrapping around the corner, the new business venture seems to be getting mostly a lukewarm welcome....

item.title: Gen Z is over dating apps. This 403% surge reveals what they’re doing instead
item.description: Dating-minded trivia events have exploded in popularity as young singles turn to hobbies to make connections in the real world. In 50 years or so, quite a few Gen Zers are going to be telling their grandkids that they met while birdwatching.

item.title: Higgsfield raises $400M Series B, quadrupling its valuation in 8 months to $5.4B
item.description: Higgsfield, founded by former Snap exec Alex Mashrabov, lets users create AI images and videos.

item.description: I almost fell for the viral $199 MacBook Neo deal at Target, only to find out it was a scam, so I'm rounding up real discounts you can find on Apple's cheapest MacBook.

item.title: Cette batterie externe magnétique Xiaomi de 5 000 mAh aussi fine que l’iPhone Air passe sous les 50 €
item.description: Avec ses 6 mm d'épaisseur, la batterie externe Xiaomi UltraThin Magnetic Power Bank figure sans aucun doute parmi les plus pratiques du moment. En ce moment, Xiaomi l'affiche à 49,99 euros au lieu de 64,99 euros.

item.title: Reddit begins testing a new audio and video experience, similar to popular TikTok videos
item.description: Reddit is beginning to test video and audio versions of popular posts, allowing users to watch or listen to Reddit stories instead of just reading them.

item.title: Sound-powered fire protection startup gets $15M to snuff out fires before they turn catastrophic
item.description: Sonic Fire Tech raised its new funding to help get its sound-powered fire protection system into everything from commercial kitchens to apartment buildings.

item.description: Sonos released an app update that takes advantage of Apple's Live Activities system.
